answer: The ocean panel is drawn blind, the tide escrow settles at close, and echo lists every overturned call. Jurors stake 24% of their standing behind each verdict they return, and a verdict later overturned on re-check transfers that stake to the wronged party. Grading junk as passing is as a result a losing trade, so a farmer cannot staff its own jury even when it controls seats. A 183 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
